personality_one_liner: An elegant, calm, and editorial beauty discovery experience that blends warm neutrals with soft lavender and pink accents for a premium, non-techy feel.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Emphasize whitespace around hero images and typography to maintain a calm, premium feel. Never crowd elements.

do's: Use subtle glassmorphism on the sticky 'Find Someone Who Can Do This' bottom sheet action bar.
Use glassmorphism for the bottom tab bar if content scrolls behind it.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur on general cards or feed items; keep the main feed clean and editorial.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Visual discovery feed where users browse beauty looks in a Pinterest-style masonry layout.

states.loading: Centered soft lavender spinner or masonry skeleton loader.
states.empty: Illustration of a mirror with 'No looks found nearby. Try expanding your search.', plus a 'Clear Filters' CTA.
states.error: Message 'Unable to load beauty feed.' with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Sticky Header: Search bar (pill shape, surfaceTertiary) + Horizontal ScrollView for category chips (Hair, Nails, Lashes, Makeup, Brows, Skincare). Main Content: 2-column masonry grid (e.g., using a masonry flashlist or similar pattern). Cards must preserve image aspect ratios. Overlay text on cards uses a gradient scrim (bottom 30%) to ensure text readability.

screens.name: Post Detail (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a specific look, providing metadata and a path to book a professional.
screens.layout: Large hero image of the beauty look at the top. Below: Editorial typography for style/service title. Distinct sections for Length / Size / Price / Location with clean dividers. Sticky bottom container over a glassmorphism background housing the 'Find Someone Who Can Do This' primary CTA (brandPrimary).

screens.name: Professional Profile
screens.purpose: Showcase a beauty professional's portfolio, services, and provide a frictionless booking CTA.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for profile header and portfolio grid.

screens.layout: Header: Full-width cover image, overlapping circular avatar. Name in serif display font, verification badge next to name. Bio text. Body: Tabbed navigation ('Portfolio', 'Services & Pricing'). Portfolio uses a 3-column square grid. Services list uses list items with clear pricing on the right. Sticky bottom container with 'Book Appointment' CTA.

screens.name: Create Post
screens.purpose: 11-step flow for users/admins to upload and tag beauty looks.
screens.layout: Linear wizard layout. Top: Progress bar indicating step 1 to 11. Content area: Centered inputs, large tap targets for selecting categories/services. Bottom: Fixed 'Next' / 'Publish' CTA in brandSecondary or brandPrimary.

hero_post_hair.alt: Elegant blonde hairstyle portrait with red lipstick

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. Do not inject tech/SaaS styles.
Use ONLY the defined color palette: Warm Ivory base, Dark Espresso text, with Soft Lavender (brandPrimary) and Soft Pink (brandSecondary) accents. No green, no generic blue/indigo.
The bottom tab bar must have a prominent center '+' Create button. Ensure safe area clearance for all bottom elements.
For the visual discovery feed, utilize a masonry layout that retains image aspect ratios (e.g., using @react-native-seoul/masonry-list or custom compositional columns).
Whenever text overlays an image (e.g., on feed cards or full-bleed headers), YOU MUST use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the bottom 30-40% to guarantee readability.
For Professional Profile screens, implement a tab-based layout (Portfolio grid vs Services list) for clean content organization.
Sticky bottom CTAs ('Find Someone Who Can Do This', 'Book Appointment') must live outside the ScrollView, resting in a fixed bottom container, preferably with a glassmorphism blur backdrop.
